finalText:
Migration's done. 12 files were still calling `db.query` — cohort, sla, macroAdmin, session, supplier, teamService, variantAdmin, apiKeyAdmin, couponService, returnService, refund, and shipment — and all now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

I left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone since it's vendored code, and didn't touch the unrelated `cache.query` calls. The verify script confirms every site moved and the modules still work.
